title: Argentinian Apple Gratin
description: A classic Argentinian dessert made with caramelized apples, crispy gratin topping, and a touch of sweetness.

ingredients.name: apples
ingredients.notes: Granny Smith or other firm variety

instructions: Peel, core, and slice apples into 1-inch wedges.
In a large bowl, mix together flour, almonds, and vanilla extract.
Add sliced apples to the bowl and toss to coat with dry ingredients.
Transfer apple mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a small bowl, mix together brown sugar and a pinch of salt.
Sprinkle sugar mixture evenly over the apple mixture.
Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until top is golden brown.
Serve warm, topped with additional almonds if desired.
